name: GPT Realtime Translate
short: OpenAI's streaming speech-to-speech translation model converting live dialogue across 70+ spoken languages into 13 output languages with simultaneous audio streaming.
modalities: Audio, text in; audio, text out
standout: Simultaneous end-to-end voice translation without intermediary text-to-speech roundtrips.
tradeoff: Specialized translation pipe; conversational agent reasoning is delegated to conversational models.
